title: Break glass: the owner alone authorises it, one action at a time, never a session or a day; during it the seat runs with bypass permissions and after it the seat is back to its role; hotfixes and maintenance go through it; production zero
text: Owner, 2026-10-11 18:42Z: 'Ensure you have the ability to break glass anything too. Just in case the user authorizes it. Only the user can authorize you to do it, and it's always one time, not one session, not the whole day, it's one time only then ask again. Each and every time on anything break glass. So that's a wild card to everything. And they should have the ability to be turned into bypass permissions when break glass happens. We don't want hang ups for maintenance, hotfixes require break glass. Treat as a production zero.' Binding: a break.glass record names one seat and one action; it is valid only with an owner answer from the bearings page for that record id; seat.sh flips that seat to bypassPermissions for that one action and restores the role settings when the action's record lands; a second action needs a second answer; every break glass is a record the board shows.
